hypothesis: The native exact constraint solver can learn a sufficient representation from fitting observations rather than requiring a manually supplied polynomial degree. This should recover more unfamiliar combinations than a complete-basis memory or stopped strict-gain greedy learner, without sacrificing honest abstention.
evidence_class: Exploratory DEVELOPMENT comparison on previously consumed synthetic sources. Existing CKAD09/11 negatives frozen. New distinct training mechanism, NOT greedy-rule repair/retuning or original scientific qualification. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS or unique-native-superiority claim even if all development gates pass.

method.source: Same isolated pinned complete-basis native accumulator interface as CKAD09; only slot0,8..2048 unique observations divisible4, context_bits1..10, engineering_fixture_only.
method.order: Unchanged ckad09:input-order:{mask} SHA256; first75% FIT, remaining25% CALIBRATION. No eval labels.
method.training: Run existing NativeContextBasis.stage_fit on FIT rows, generic monomial maximum degrees1..context_bits+1 in ascending order. Select FIRST degree consistent with all FIT constraints. No named family, coefficient sparsity target, preprogrammed answer/operator family, greedy edits or score-driven tuning. Stop degree search immediately at first FIT-consistent class, BEFORE reading calibration outcomes.
method.gate: Validate that selected model identifies and correctly predicts EVERY calibration input. If any prediction is wrong OR unidentified, abstain globally. Do NOT try a higher degree after calibration failure. All output remains PROVISIONAL_ONLY because polynomial class ordering is a supplied inductive bias, not proved semantics.
method.state: Immutable selected native coefficients/support plus source/fit/calibration hashes, rejected-degree trace and gate counts. No training outcome table. Strict canonical cold restoration using external SHA; no accepted model mutation. Optional new class only; all existing modules remain exact.
method.control: Independent existing CKAD02 lowest-pivot SET-XOR solver repeats ascending FIT-only consistency selection and one-shot calibration; match selected degree, trace/gate and all2048 parameter-space predictions. Identical supplied assumption; expected tie is explicitly NOT superiority.
